patch.value: Source-tree folder-density program: bounded directory fan-out via domain-noun subfolders (zero feature loss)

Inter-file half of the 2026-07-12 too-many/too-long directive (intra-file LOC half = pm-yh8r): regroup high-fan-out directories (src/cli/commands 72, tests/unit/commands 60, tests/integration 32, scripts 23, src/cli 19) into domain-noun subfolders per the disposition blueprint in the body, in 6 fenced tranches.

Every tracked source directory holds ≤~20 direct files or carries a documented exemption in this body; all moves land as import-specifier-only refactors with full gates green per tranche and byte-identical CLI/MCP/contract surface; pm files links updated for moved paths on open items in the same tranche; vitest/eslint-suppressions/coverage/package.json/workflow/docs references updated within the moving tranche

## Why (2026-07-12 maintainer directive: too many files per folder + too-long files; document-only pass)
The intra-file effective-LOC half of this directive class is owned by pm-yh8r (census current as of its 2026-07-12 note; sdk/runtime.ts 3388/3400 is #1 at-risk). THIS item owns the inter-file half: tracked-file fan-out per source directory. Census (git ls-files, direct children only):

- src/cli/commands 72 (~55 command modules interleaved with ~17 cross-command helper modules; `extension/` and `test/` subfolders already exist as grouping precedent)
- tests/unit/commands 60 (mirror of the above)
- tests/integration 32 · scripts 23 · tests/unit/scripts 23 · src/cli 19 · src/core/shared 18 · docs 18 · src/sdk 16 · src/core/item 16 · src/core/extensions 16 · tests/helpers 16

OUT OF SCOPE: `.agents/pm/**` fan-out (history 1758, tasks 567, issues 397) — tracker-store bucketing is owned by pm-0qg5 (format_version-gated migration); never double-file.

## Target policy
- Soft ceiling ~20 direct files per source directory; exceedances need a grouping move or a documented exemption in this body.
- Group by DOMAIN NOUN (align with the pm-n7rr grammar nouns), never by file kind — no `utils/`/`helpers/` dumping grounds; a single `shared/` module folder per level is the one sanctioned exception.
- Tests mirror src 1:1 — every src move carries its mirrored spec move in the same commit.

## Disposition blueprint (per directory)
1. src/cli/commands (72 → ≤20 root + noun subfolders):
   - Cross-command support → `commands/shared/`: event-validation-messages, item-filter-options, legacy-none-tokens, lifecycle-transitions, linked-artifacts, linked-test-entry, linked-test-parsers, list-filter-shared, metadata-normalizers, mutation-command-options, recurrence-parsers, repeatable-metadata-parsers, scheduling-shortcuts, search-pagination, search-rendering, shared-unset-fields, init-agent-guidance.
   - Noun families into per-noun folders (extension/ + test/ precedent): `history/` (history, history-compact, history-redact, history-repair) · `test/` (test, test-all, test-runs joining existing linked-command-detection) · `annotations/` (notes, learnings, comments, comments-audit) · `maintenance/` (normalize, reindex, gc, dedupe-audit, dedupe-merge).
   - Remaining single-verb modules stay at root.
2. src/cli (19 direct): help family (help-content, help-json-payload, guide-topics, commander-usage, error-guidance) → `cli/help/`; parser family (shared-parsers, argv-utils, bootstrap-args) → `cli/parsing/`; register-* + registration-helpers stay (registration IS this folder's identity); main.ts stays (entry point, wired in package/bin).
3. scripts (23 direct): smoke-*.mjs + plugin-mcp-smoke-harness.mjs → `scripts/smoke/`; release-version.mjs, generate-release-notes.mjs, sync-versions.mjs → `scripts/release/`; bundle-cli.mjs, prepare-build-cache.mjs, finalize-build.mjs, gen-*.mjs → `scripts/build/`; run-tests.mjs + install.sh/install.ps1 + check-secrets*.mjs STAY at root (README curl paths, CI invocations, contributor muscle memory) — verify EVERY consumer (package.json scripts, .github/workflows, docs, other scripts) before moving any script.
4. tests/integration (32): group by surface — `cli/`, `mcp/`, `extensions/`, `release/`, `telemetry/`; tests/unit/scripts follows the scripts/ regrouping mirror.
5. AT-threshold, no move yet (re-evaluate at T6): src/core/shared 18 (it is the sanctioned shared level), src/sdk 16 (PR#396 barrel split + cli-contracts/ already relieved it; pm-usfg partition will re-shape it), src/core/item 16, src/core/extensions 16, tests/helpers 16.
6. docs 18: navigated via the AGENTS.md progressive-disclosure map, not by folder browsing — exempt.

## Constraints (why this is not a mechanical mv)
- Zero feature/behavior loss: bin entry, package exports, contract tables, MCP tool surface, completion output byte-identical; moves are import-specifier-only refactors.
- Sequencing fence: files inside the SDK-promotion partition (pm-usfg slices pm-3mna/pm-zwpp/pm-oxrw/pm-4a7m/pm-oslr) and pm-yh8r decomposition targets move WITH their slice/split, never in a separate churn pass — one migration per file, no double conflict surface against active lanes.
- Reference-churn checklist per tranche: ESM relative import specifiers (.js), vitest.config.ts path-keyed excludes (big legacy files listed by path), eslint-suppressions.json path keys (A+ source of truth, max 17), coverage literal all-src globs, package.json script paths, .github/workflows script invocations, docs command examples, jscpd/CodeFactor path baselines.
- pm tracked file-links: every moved path strands `pm files` links → files_missing rises above the 155/122 baseline owned by pm-j8z6. Each tranche updates links on OPEN items it touches; closed-item drift is handed to the pm-j8z6 reconciliation (CREATE-ONLY on closed items — never mutate them).
- `git mv` per file for rename detection; ONE directory family per PR tranche, each independently green through the full gate set.

## Tranche order (each tranche = one PR)
T1 scripts/ regrouping (lowest blast radius, zero src imports) → T2 tests/integration surface folders → T3 src/cli/commands `shared/` extraction → T4 src/cli/commands noun folders (excluding usfg/yh8r-fenced files) → T5 src/cli help/ + parsing/ → T6 re-census + threshold re-check after the pm-usfg partition lands.

value.text: Repository-root organization observations from the ecosystem review 2026-07-25, scoped to this item's structure remit (no new item filed per the three-item fence with pm-yh8r and pm-0qg5). (1) PRD.md sits at the root at 118KB / 1,759 lines, self-labelled 'Draft v1' and 'archival planning reference', Last Updated 2026-05-12 — two and a half months stale — while its own navigation block routes readers to docs/ and to .toon item paths. It is the single largest hand-authored document in the repo and the only large one outside docs/. Candidate disposition: move under docs/ as an explicitly archival page, or retire it in favour of the tracker, which is the stated system of record. (2) Two foreign toolchain caches persist at the root — .mypy_cache/ and .pytest_cache/ — in a repository with no Python source. They stay invisible to git status only because each writes its own self-ignoring .gitignore, so the repo's own .gitignore does not mention them and a fresh clone plus any stray Python run recreates them. (3) Root currently carries 12 tool-config dotfiles (.codefactor.yml, .deepscan.json, .deepsource.toml, .jscpd.json, .trivyignore, .trufflehog-exclude-paths.txt, codecov.yml, eslint.config.mjs, eslint-suppressions.json plus four tsconfig variants), which is the main driver of root fan-out now that source is organised.

Benchmark-root triplication found by live inspection 2026-07-25 (evening ecosystem review) — scoped to this item's structure remit, no new item filed per the three-item fence with pm-yh8r and pm-0qg5. The repository carries THREE tracked benchmark locations whose names do not distinguish their roles:

(1) benchmarks/ at the repository root — 3 vitest microbenchmarks (bm25, pagination, text-normalization), wired by vitest.bench.config.ts include "benchmarks/**/*.bench.ts".
(2) scripts/bench/ — 7 files, the real CI budget surface: run-scale-benchmarks.mjs, scale-workspace.mjs, cli-transport-floor.mjs, sdk-entrypoint-costs.mjs plus three committed budget JSONs. Wired by six package.json scripts and, for two of them, by quality:static itself.
(3) scripts/benchmarks/ — a ONE-file directory holding graph-adapter-scale.mjs, differing from its sibling (2) by pluralization only. It has no package.json script and no CI wiring; its sole reference in the repo is a shell snippet inside docs/RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH.md line 162. It is the clearest instance of the "unorganized and confusing" symptom in the tree: a name-collided singleton that reads as a peer of the gated benchmark suite while being unreachable from any entrypoint.

Candidate disposition, cheapest first: fold scripts/benchmarks/graph-adapter-scale.mjs into scripts/bench/ (it is a scale harness like run-scale-benchmarks.mjs), update the RELATIONSHIP_GRAPH.md reference, and delete the empty directory; then decide whether root benchmarks/ belongs under scripts/bench/vitest/ or stays at root because vitest.bench.config.ts and the CodSpeed workflow address it there. Note the two roles are genuinely different (vitest microbenchmarks vs node budget gates), so the fix is naming and colocation, not merging the harnesses.

Adjacent observation, recorded but NOT claimed as duplication given the deliberate SDK docs partition: docs/ now holds six SDK-prefixed pages (SDK.md 2,950 lines plus SDK_CONTEXT_COORDINATION, SDK_CONTEXT_INTEGRITY_PRIMITIVES, SDK_CUSTOMIZATION_PRIMITIVES, SDK_PRIMITIVE_INVENTORY, and EXTENSION_AUTHOR_CONTRACTS) and three plugin pages whose names overlap (CODEX_PLUGIN.md 43 lines vs CHATGPT_CODEX_PLUGIN_IMPLEMENTATION.md 774 lines). Root telemetry tooling is correctly out of the tree: scripts/prod is gitignored with zero tracked files, confirmed this pass.

src/sdk at 81 flat files is the largest single offender and also the one with the clearest domain-noun structure available: it already has query/, graph/, governance/, test/, extension/ and cli-contracts/ subfolders, so 81 files sit alongside six existing groupings rather than in an unstructured directory. That makes it the lowest-risk tranche to take first, and the highest-value one — src/sdk is the directory a package author browses to understand the public surface, and it is currently the least legible directory in the repository.

The tests tree mirrors the source tree's fan-out one-for-one (65 commands, 50 sdk), which is worth noting as a constraint rather than a separate problem: a source tranche that moves files without moving their specs doubles the confusion instead of halving it. The fence recorded on this item — files move with their split — should be read as covering the spec alongside the module.

Root is at 32 entries, which is unremarkable for a repository of this kind and is not the source of the reported confusion; the fan-out inside src and tests is.

Census refresh (2026-07-28) — the blueprint in this item's description is now stale in a way that changes which tranche should go first.

Directories over the ~20-file policy, current tree:

```
86  src/sdk                (44,681 LOC at the top level alone)
66  tests/unit/commands
66  src/cli/commands
36  tests/integration
26  src/cli
22  src/core/extensions
22  scripts
```

The description names `src/cli/commands 72, tests/unit/commands 60, tests/integration 32, scripts 23, src/cli 19`. Two things moved since:

1. **`src/sdk` is not in the blueprint at all and is now the worst directory in the repo by a wide margin** — 86 top-level files, 20 more than the next. This is a direct consequence of the pm-usfg SDK-first promotion landing slice after slice into a flat namespace: `runtime.ts` 4,040 LOC, `extension.ts` 3,777, `testing.ts` 2,846, `schema.ts` 2,434, `config.ts` 2,030, `compose.ts` 1,834.
2. `src/sdk` already has the right shape available — `cli-contracts/`, `extension/`, `governance/`, `graph/`, `merge/`, `query/`, `test/` all exist. The subfolder convention was established and then not applied to the files that kept arriving, so the fix is draining the top level into folders that already exist rather than inventing a taxonomy.

`src/cli` also drifted 19 → 26. Everything else is stable or slightly worse.

Suggested re-ordering: `src/sdk` should lead the tranche sequence, not be absent from it. It is also where the fence in this item matters most — the pm-yh8r LOC-decomposition targets (`runtime.ts`, `extension.ts`) sit in exactly this directory, so those files must move with their split rather than being relocated first and split later.
